title: Official I-006 trim-mode matrix (handles, cross-link, locked tracks)
modesOfficialized: leave-gap TrimClip (in/out shorten; lengthen into a gap)
assertions: handles: sourceRange inside available stream; shortfall is SOURCE_OUT_OF_RANGE or existing INVALID_RANGE; leave-gap collision does not delete a neighbor
cross-link: linked AV stays whole-group; locked audio partner is FIELD_LOCKED
locked tracks/fields: host track, partner track, or sourceRange is whole-group FIELD_LOCKED and does not half-write
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of path-sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
remainingScope: 含轨锁/syncLock/link/unlink/多轨边界；不静默破同步。
